instructions.body: Vehicle work is behavior-first. Define observed and expected behavior before changing parameters.
Never infer physical meaning from a variable name alone. Verify runtime ownership, units, configuration and evidence.
Two equivalent failed attempts trigger diagnostic mode. Query common problems and gather new evidence before another implementation attempt.
Do not claim success without tests, telemetry, scene load, compiler output or equivalent verifiable evidence.
Use surgical scene edits and structural validation. Preserve exported NodePath/reference metadata.
C++/GDExtension owns performance-sensitive native runtime responsibilities. Avoid allocations, blocking I/O and unnecessary logging in hot loops.
Python is support/offline tooling for this project unless an explicit architectural decision changes that boundary.
